description.value: The Modest Butcher is a full-service restaurant and market situated on the grounds of Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery in West Kelowna, offering locally sourced meats, handcrafted cocktails, and an award-winning wine portfolio. The kitchen serves everything from casual burgers to tomahawk steaks dry-aged in-house, with a playful, irreverent personality that has made it a notable Okanagan dining destination since 2020. A touring cyclist looking for a substantial sit-down meal with local wine in the West Kelowna area will find this a solid stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at modestbutcher.com is live and confirms the business as a real, open restaurant-and-market located at Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery in West Kelowna; phone (250 769 8803), full address (829 Douglas Road, West Kelowna, BC, V1Z 1N9), and website all corroborate OSM tags. The menu page explicitly lists 'THE VEGANATOR BLT' with tempeh bacon and smoky vegan mayo, confirming at least one vegan option. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag shows 11:00 start but website header states 11:30am; OSM may be slightly out of date. Website notes seasonal hours may vary.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by active website with current menu and booking system; no grounds for exclusion.
